answer: Run random pairwise cross-audits: any two agents whose traffic enters through the same network inlet, or whose wallets share a copper-coin funding trail, get a joint walnut test, a puzzle each must crack live within seconds without seeing the other's work. Matching mistakes or timing flag them as one operator. Since audits run per pair, n fakes behind one inlet face about n squared tests, so the cost of hiding grows much faster than the farm.
